biomes.label: Temperate woodland
biomes.guide: Broadleaf forest, heath and farmland with four seasons: most of Europe, eastern North America, northern China, Korea and Japan.

biomes.label: Northern forest and tundra
biomes.guide: Conifer forest, lakes, tundra and ice: Scandinavia, Siberia, Canada, Alaska and the Arctic edge.

biomes.label: Cool rainforest
biomes.guide: Wet, mild forest of giant conifers, ferns and moss on mountainous coasts: the Pacific Northwest, New Zealand, southern Chile, Tasmania and western Norway.

biomes.label: Mediterranean hills
biomes.guide: Hot dry summers, mild wet winters, scrub-covered hills and rocky coasts: the Mediterranean, California, central Chile, the Cape and south-west Australia.

biomes.label: Steppe and prairie
biomes.guide: Vast treeless grassland with hot summers and bitter winters: the Eurasian steppe from Hungary to Mongolia, the North American plains and the pampas.

biomes.label: Desert
biomes.guide: Sand seas, stony plains, wadis and oases: the Sahara, Arabia, central Asia's deserts, the American south-west, the Atacama and Australia's interior.

biomes.label: Savannah
biomes.guide: Tall grass, scattered trees and a long dry season: eastern and southern Africa, the Sahel's southern edge, northern Australia, the Brazilian cerrado and India's Deccan.

biomes.label: Tropical rainforest
biomes.guide: Hot, wet, evergreen forest under a closed canopy, laced with great rivers: the Amazon, the Congo basin, Borneo, Sumatra and lowland New Guinea.

biomes.label: Monsoon lands
biomes.guide: Wet and dry seasons, river plains, paddy fields, bamboo and teak forest: India, Bangladesh, mainland South-East Asia, southern China and Java.

biomes.label: Tropical islands
biomes.guide: Volcanic peaks, coral atolls, lagoons and open ocean: Polynesia, Micronesia, Melanesia, the Caribbean and the Indonesian and Philippine archipelagos.

biomes.label: High mountains
biomes.guide: Cold, thin-aired country above the forests: the Andes, the Himalaya and Tibet, the Pamirs, the Ethiopian highlands, the high Alps and New Guinea's highland basins.
